summary: Converts ModuleNotFoundError for packages of the [http] dependency stack into a typed MissingExtraError naming the extra to install. HTTP_STACK lists the top-level module names covered (mountainash_settings, mountainash_auth_client, pydantic, upath, httpx, fsspec). Any other import failure, including a missing backend SDK or a partial-import ImportError, is re-raised unchanged.
key_functions: raise_for_missing_extra(feature: str, extra: str, exc: ImportError) -> NoReturn — raise MissingExtraError (with .extra, .feature, chained from exc) when exc is a ModuleNotFoundError for an HTTP_STACK module; otherwise re-raise exc
extension_points: Subpackages that need the [http] stack wrap their imports in try/except ImportError and call raise_for_missing_extra(feature, 'http', exc); used by _core/http, connections, settings, settings profiles, path_helpers and s3_path
lifecycle_notes: Fires at import time of an [http]-dependent subpackage, which (through the lazy root) means on first attribute access of a root name such as StorageFacade remote paths, StoragePath or create_connection
documentation_hooks: Installation/extras page: what MissingExtraError looks like and how to fix it
Maintainer note: how to make a new subpackage base-install safe (guard imports, call raise_for_missing_extra, keep tests/test_slim_install.py green)
risks: Only HTTP_STACK modules are converted: missing boto3, paramiko or python-gnupg are re-raised as plain ModuleNotFoundError even though the extra parameter is free-form, so [s3]/[sftp]/[encryption] absence does not yield MissingExtraError through this helper (tests/_core/test_extras.py asserts boto3 is not converted)
HTTP_STACK must be kept in step with the [http] extra in pyproject.toml by hand; a new dependency added to [http] but not to HTTP_STACK leaks a raw ModuleNotFoundError
open_questions: Is the conversion intentionally limited to the [http] stack, or should backend-SDK extras ([s3], [sftp], [encryption]) also map to MissingExtraError with a per-extra module set?

evidence.detail: stack modules convert; boto3, pydantic_core and partial ImportError are not converted
